resolution.question: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO signed the lease before the cutoff (2026-08-21T17:00:00+01:00). Resolve NO if the CEO explicitly walks away or the deadline passes without signing.
